title: ALTER TABLE
description: Add, alter, and drop columns and constraints.

data.title: Alter Table
data.code:
ALTER TABLE users
  ADD COLUMN phone TEXT,
  ALTER COLUMN display_name SET NOT NULL,
  ADD CONSTRAINT users_phone_key UNIQUE (phone),
  DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS legacy_id;

data.title: Locks
data.text: Some ALTER TABLE commands require an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock.
